capabilities: Pull changed OmegaVault memories as ready-to-write Markdown files with frontmatter
Poll the OmegaVault API on an interval using a bearer API token
Rename files on title changes and remove files via deletion tombstones
Run manual Sync now or Full resync that resets the cursor
Configure server URL, API token, vault folder, and poll interval
disambiguation: Not a two-way vault sync; it only pulls from OmegaVault, which stays the source of truth and overwrites local edits.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copy build output into .obsidian/plugins) or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull content from an external OmegaVault memory service into vault notes.

relations.evidence: Or install via BRAT by pointing it at this repo.

summary: One-way sync plugin that pulls OmegaVault memories into a vault as frontmattered Markdown notes, keyed by omegavault_id.
